Naming rules require stripping address residue. The base data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_panel_offset is fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, ui domain, descriptive, and 'offset' correctly reflects the scalar's data type (a horizontal placement offset). purpose: Horizontal placement offset latch for the corner 'terrain info' HUD panel; added to (panel_dst_base + render_stride*0x9D) to position the panel so it never covers the battle cursor.
logic_summary: A single .object2 mutable scalar dword. Sole accessor fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel (0x1ACF3) latches it: 0xF2 (right column) when cursor_screen_y>5 && cursor_screen_x<3 (cursor top-left), 1 (left column) when cursor_screen_y>5 && cursor_screen_x>9 (cursor bottom-right), otherwise keeps the previous value. The reader then computes panel_base = buf + stride*0x9D + this_offset. Confirmed by disasm: writes MOV dword[0x51A0C],0xF2 @0x1AD3C and MOV dword[0x51A0C],0x1 @0x1AD5A; read ADD EBP,dword[0x51A0C] @0x1AD6C (plain 32-bit load).
datatype: uint32 (dword, 4 bytes; Ghidra dtype dword len=4)
element_semantics: Scalar: signed/unsigned-agnostic horizontal byte offset into the render surface row; only two latched values occur at runtime -- 0xF2 (242, panel drawn on the right column) and 0x1 (panel drawn on the left column). Static initial value 1 (left position) before the first latch write.
